message.reasoning_content: Card 8 cancels promissory notes — I have none. Others produced, no credit seen. Harmless either way. As president, veto not needed. Others voted already? voted=[false,true,true] — unknown how. Pass/abstain. Card 8 could hurt if I plan sell_credit, but I won't rely on it. Vote no? If it passes and later I use sell_credit before law... law happens after market, so card 8 would cancel this round's credit sales. I don't plan credits; but it may hurt rivals. Abstain.
